title: buchanania florida var. lucida
intro: Buchanania florida var. lucida, commonly known as the 'Silver Leaf Calophyllum', is a plant species belonging to the Calophyllaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and aiding in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Buchanania florida var. lucida include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
